apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.31 — Loop timing fix: loop passes are now kept queued three deep on the player, so repetitions play sample-exactly back to back. A late scheduling callback can no longer leave a gap at the seam, and the playhead stays locked to the audible loop over any number of repeats.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
